title: All-in-one dual CRISPR-Cas12a (AIOD-CRISPR) assay protocol for SARS-CoV-2 detection
protocol: Thaw all frozen reagents thoroughly before use.
Run PCR to amplify 316 bp SARS-CoV-2 N gene sequence in the pUCIDT plasmid.
Pipette 20 μL of the PCR products for 2% agarose gel electrophoresis analysis.
Cut the band at the size of about 336 bp.
Gel extract the purified PCR products using PureLink™ Quick Gel Extraction Kit.
Confirm the sequence by shipping the purified PCR products to Genewiz® for Sanger sequencing.

Incubate the solution containing 8 μL of 5× T7 Transcription Buffer, 3 μL each of 100 mM rNTPs, 4 μL of the Enzyme Mix with T7 RNA polymerase, and 16 μL of the gel-extracted PCR products at 37°C for 4 h.
Treat the transcription products using DNase to degrade DNA.
Purify the resulting RNA using the RNeasy® MinElute™ Cleanup Kit.
Determine the purity and concentration of collected nucleic acid using NanoDrop™ One/One C Microvolume UV-Vis Spectrophotometry.
Keep synthetic RNA at -80°C before use.

Mix 12.5 μL of 2× Reaction Buffer, 2.5 μL of 10× Basic E-mix, 1.25 μL of 280 mM MgOAc, 0.08 μL of 100 μM FP, 0.08 μL of 100 μM RP, 0.2 μL of 100 mM dATP, 0.2 μL of 100 mM dGTP, 0.2 μL of 100 mM dTTP, 0.2 μL of 100 mM dCTP, and 0.8 μL of 10 U/μL AMV reverse transcriptase to prepare Component A.
Mix 2 μL of ssDNA-FQ with 1.25 μL of 20× Core Reaction Buffer to prepare Component B.
Add 0.5 μL of synthetic RNA or extracted nucleic acid solutions into Component A.
Add 3.25 μL of prepared Component B to the mixture containing Component A.
Vortex the assembled mixture thoroughly and invert the tube 3 times.
Centrifuge the tube slightly after vortexing.
Mix 0.32 μL of 50 μM crRNA1, 0.32 μL of 50 μM crRNA2, 0.32 μL of 100 μM EnGen® Lba Cas12a (Cpf1), and 0.28 μL nuclease-free water to prepare Component C.
Leave the mixture for about 10 min at room temperature.
Pipette 1.24 μL of prepared Component C into the assembled mixture from Step 3.
Vortex the reaction system thoroughly and invert the tube 3 times after adding Component C.
Centrifuge the tube slightly after vortexing the final reaction system.
Incubate the final reaction system at 37°C for 20-40 min prior to fluorescence detection.
Incubate the AIOD-CRISPR reaction systems in the CFX96 Touch™ Real-Time PCR Detection System for real-time fluorescence detection.
